limitations: All histories previously inspected; family definitions exploratory, not independently validated
OHLC conservative simulator differs from TradingView broker emulator; no direct native performance improvement claim
80 trials are related; Holm controls formal familywise error only under valid individual null p-values, which dependence/stationarity here do not establish
